title: Euterpe agent: config.yaml
description: How the agent interacts: note or audio input, grid (clock) or event mode, and the clock.

title.description: The system's name, shown on the start screen.

noteMode.description: The user plays notes (laptop keyboard, MIDI keyboard, on-screen keyboard).

audioMode.description: The agent gets the microphone: processAudioBuffer is called for every frame.

status.description: processNoteEvent is called for every user note, as it happens.
processClockEvent is called on every clock tick.

eventBuffer.description: The clock event carries userNotes: every user note since the last tick.

quantizedEvents.description: The clock event carries userQuantizedNotes: the user's notes on this tick, aligned to the grid.

input.description: At most this many simultaneous user notes in userQuantizedNotes.

delayedExecution.description: Run the agent a quarter tick after the tick, to catch notes played slightly late (better score alignment).

windowSize.description: Samples per frame passed to processAudioBuffer.

autoStart.description: Start the clock when the user presses the start button.

clockPeriod.description: A fixed tick period in ms (free time); null to use BPM and ticksPerBeat.

introModal.description: Show agent/intro.md when the page opens.
